description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance on a 3-turn loft coil (multi-turn, tight pancake).
rationale: Locks in the cross-section-centroid chain method for loft-of-profiles solids.  Kubota's 3turncoil geometry (385 circle cross-sections spiralled through 3 turns, Z-pitch ~1.3mm) is the acid test for the centroid NN-chain with tangent continuity: naive NN jumps between turns and doubles the path length.  Verified 2026-04-28: STEP-only path (no .jou) produces 426.265 nH within 0.004% of the analytic-equivalent reference 426.25 nH.  Since 4.13.0 the .jou input was retired; the canonical input is STEP and the centerline + cross-section are auto-extracted from B-Rep.

sample.comment: File lives on Kubota's 100号機 share (W:) not in-repo (4 MB).  Test skips if unavailable rather than duplicating the binary in the repo.  Coordinates in metres (CLAUDE.md m-only policy).

regression_guard.comment: Hard band around analytic-equivalent 426 nH.  2026-04-21 bugs that hit this: (1) longest-edge heuristic on loft-of-circles gave L=4.78 nH; (2) GeomType string compare 'PLANE' missed enum; (3) NN chain without tangent continuity got path=1280mm (~2x).  After tangent-continuity bias was added, STEP-only produces 426.27 nH consistently.
